slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept active for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be used or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not inquire about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The required area for each month — is it a minimum that must be met (renting more than required is allowed), or must the rented area match the required area exactly?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly match the required area or whether over/under supply is allowed.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When multiple warehouses are rented in parallel, is the objective to minimize the total rental cost across all warehouses combined ... or is there some other objective?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract types is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum-diversity requirement and did not include any such constraint in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of distinct contract types that can be used.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts and omitted any such constraint from the model summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is used for its entire coverage period, with no partial usage.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether contracts must be kept for the full term; the READY_TO_MODEL summary implicitly assumes full-period coverage.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved and was silently assumed away.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 objective and exact-demand slots, but stopped without clarifying the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and also missed the P2 full-coverage and max-distinct-contracts details, leaving material business constraints unmodeled.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
